overview: India Career Counseling (ICC) is a full-featured educational counseling portal for students and parents. Explore courses, learn about services, read career blogs, connect with counselors, and manage all content through a protected admin panel.
features: Animated hero with counters and gradient
8 public pages including 5 service detail pages
Blog with 9 articles and detail pages
Protected admin panel for CRUD management
Mobile responsive with Indian saffron/navy theme
